pm_active.meaning: executeHedge is called with PM active

blp_reserve_exists.meaning: BLP has an active reserve for the spot asset token

accounting_reads_succeed.meaning: accounting reads and yield settlement calls (totalBackingSigned, surplus, distributableSurplus, settleDailyPnL gate 3) complete without reverting

accounting_bricked_observed.meaning: every accounting read and yield settlement call is permanently bricked until an operator calls removeSuppliedEntry to remove the bad registry entry

assumptions: executeHedge buys the spot asset on L1 and registers it in the accountant's vaultSupplied registry via notifyVaultSupply.
The vaultSupplied registration is unconditional with no check that BLP has an active reserve for the token.
Recovery requires an operator to call removeSuppliedEntry to remove the bad registry entry.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call executeHedge or whether the caller is unauthorized; the intent's applicability scope is limited to the PM-active, no-reserve scenario.
Report does not establish the spot asset token identity or that no reserve existed before the call beyond the conditional 'if no reserve exists'.

limitations: The impact's permanence qualifier ('permanently bricked until removeSuppliedEntry') is captured as a Boolean observable rather than a temporal model.
The specific reverting reads (totalBackingSigned, surplus, distributableSurplus, settleDailyPnL gate 3) are summarized in one completion observable.
